stories.title: Trump waives Russia sanctions, blames Zelenskyy for prolonging Ukraine war
stories.line: Trump is waiving Russia sanctions to keep peace talks alive while publicly blaming Zelenskyy for prolonging the Ukraine war.

stories.line: The federal tax filing deadline is tomorrow, and you can request an extension if you can't file in time.

stories.title: Kenya's Ebola cases rise to eight as outbreak spreads from Congo
stories.line: Kenya has confirmed eight Ebola cases, linked to the first imported case that died in Nairobi, as the DRC outbreak spreads regionally.

stories.line: A country musician urges fellow artists to speak out on gun violence despite fear of fan backlash after the Nashville school shooting.

stories.title: Protest riots spread across France; more than 1,800 arrested
stories.line: Riots and looting spread across France and into Milan after a night of protest violence; over 1,800 people have been arrested.

stories.title: China's growth holds at 4.5% on exports as Beijing weighs AI chip controls
stories.line: China's economy grew 4.5% last quarter on exports, while domestic demand stays weak and Beijing weighs new AI and chip export controls.

stories.title: Putin floats Trump-Xi summit on Ukraine as Western officials say Russian tank forces are going backwards
stories.line: Putin is floating a summit with Trump and Xi on Ukraine's fate while Western officials say Russia's armor is degrading, with old tanks being pressed back into service.

stories.title: Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv diverted to Sofia after bomb threat
stories.line: An Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Sofia after a reported bomb threat; all 57 aboard were evacuated and the plane searched.

stories.title: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to public benefit fund
stories.line: Anthropic will put 5% of its shares into a public benefit fund, rising as the company's value grows, subject to stockholder approval.
